task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! First off, attempt to head west. Then, make an attempt to move west. That done, try to move north. If you can accomplish that, try to head north. Then, attempt to go north. If you can do that, try to venture east. Next, make an attempt to move east. After that, go to the east. That done, venture south. Following that, make an effort to travel west. Then, travel west. With that done, recover the cookie from the floor of the steam room. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
